qualified_now: +u/dt is not the physical outward SWAP derivative under fixed-interface semantics.
P0 stability depends on groundwater-to-SWAP response ratio; PB01 supplies a divergent valid regime and F-GC44 a strongly contractive valid regime.
Physical Newton gives the best local affine factor but requires safeguarding under nonlinear finite perturbations.
Picard is a viable fallback only in r>1 regimes and can be very slow near |p|/a close to one.
A response-derived relaxation parameter can be principled, but is regime-local and may fall outside 0<alpha<=1; with exact p its linear-cancellation step is Newton algebraically.
Corrector admissibility is a separate gate from coupling contraction and must use actual TRIAL_FAILED evidence, not candidate lifecycle statuses.
